crossRefs.note: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
“Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the…
About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah…
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
